svg.text: Every agent tool call gets one decision — before it runs.
Simulated tenant · Nordlicht GmbH · No live Azure access
Gateway = FastAPI app (local lab, not an Azure service) + OPA :8181 + human approval.
Native decision at every step: none.
WHAT AZURE NATIVE DOES — AND WHERE IT STOPS
Each service has one job. None of them decides a single tool call.
